## Goal
When you finish, `packages/domain` (`@church/domain`) holds the pure-TypeScript logic modules that web (step 2.1+) and mobile (step 4.1+) both import: the 12-permission tuple with its three role groups, labels and tooltip text (including the capability-mapping sentences), one Zod enum per DB enum with a parity test against `9999_init.sql`, a TypeScript mirror of the SQL audience derivation `app.person_in_kind`, the table-driven `parseMediaLink(url, platform)`, upload/storage limits (50 MB cap while Supabase is on the Free plan) with the exact storage path builders, org-timezone date helpers, a `fixtures/persons.json` that the SQL test `supabase/tests/rls/05_audiences.sql` and the Vitest suite both consume, and a Vitest suite covering all of it (three parity tests read the migration from disk). The package has exactly one runtime dependency (`zod`), no React, no supabase-js, no Node-only APIs, so it runs unchanged under Next.js and React Native (Hermes).

## Constraints
- Runtime dependency is `zod` only (already `catalog:`). No `date-fns` here, no React, no `@supabase/*`, no Node built-ins (`crypto`, `Buffer`, `fs`) in `src/` — tests may use `node:fs` to read the SQL file. Everything must work under Hermes: no `structuredClone` reliance, no `Array.prototype.toSorted`, guard `Intl.supportedValuesOf`.
- Names are copied from `9999_init.sql` (enums, columns, RPC payload keys, error keys) — never invent a divergent spelling; when PLAN/DESIGN and the migration disagree, use the migration and record the difference in HANDOFF "Deviations from plan".
- Do not edit any file under `supabase/`; fixture changes are append-only and must keep `05_audiences.sql` green. Do not create anything in `packages/db` or `packages/supabase-client` (step 1.7a/1.7b), `apps/*` (steps 2.1/4.1), and no `src/schemas/*` beyond `enums.ts` + `index.ts` (step 1.6b).
- Zod 4 API only (`z.enum([...])` in `enums.ts`), no deprecated v3 forms; keep `strict` typing — no `any`, no non-null assertions except in tests.
- Follow the standing orders: no model names or secrets in files; never run `supabase db push`/`db reset`; commit only after `pnpm turbo lint typecheck test` is green.

- `pnpm turbo lint typecheck test` → every task succeeds; zero ESLint warnings introduced; `pnpm format:check` clean.

open_issues: Splits (orchestrator decision 13): skeleton step 1.6 became 1.6a (permissions, enums, audiences, media links, limits, dates, fixture) + 1.6b (Zod schemas, errors, URL builders); skeleton step 1.7 became 1.7a (`@church/db`) + 1.7b (`@church/supabase-client`). The assembler must rewrite dependencies in other groups: G8 3.3 `depends_on` 1.6 → 1.6b; G5 2.1 and G11 4.1 `depends_on` 1.7 → 1.7b; anything else naming 1.6/1.7 → 1.6b/1.7b.

The former 'if 1.4 created it / else create it' conditional is gone.

RESOLVED 2026-09-15 — typegen: 1.5's `scripts/db/gen-types.sh` runs `@supabase/postgres-meta` directly under Node (exact-pinned root devDependency; the Supabase CLI's `--db-url` path needs Docker). 1.7a now describes it that way, keeps the pin and never proposes `npx supabase@2.116.0`. 1.5 also records the three role-header labels and the permission-mapping text that 1.6a copies.

RESOLVED 2026-09-15 — G2's 1.3b returns `link_id`, `sermon_title`, `org_name` on `needs_password` / `needs_password_reset`; 1.6b's `shareResolveResultSchema` now requires them there. 1.6b also exports `SHARE_LINK_STATUSES` (the migration's second comment block) and `SHARE_LINK_LOAD_STATUSES` (the subset `srv_load_unlocked_share_link` returns), and 1.7a's `srvLoadUnlockedShareLink` parses with the same schema (decision 21; G8 3.4b must call it instead of re-validating in TypeScript).

Permission grouping is not spelled out in PLAN/DESIGN beyond 'Sermon manager / Announcement manager / Organization manager'. G4 fixes it from the enum order: Sermon manager = sermons.upload/delete/link; Announcement manager = announcements.create/delete/edit + bulletins.upload + documents.upload; Organization manager = users.create/delete/edit_permissions + org.settings. Founder may re-group; only `PERMISSION_GROUPS` changes.

`@church/domain` is kept zod-only (DESIGN §2). Org-timezone maths uses Intl (`Intl.DateTimeFormat`, guarded `Intl.supportedValuesOf`) rather than `date-fns`/`@date-fns/tz`; those stay in the catalog for formatting in web/mobile. If Hermes' Intl coverage turns out insufficient in step 4.1, `dates.ts` is the only file to revisit.

Names chosen by G4 in 1.6a that later groups must reuse: `parseMediaLink` failure shape `{ ok: false, reason: 'not_https' | 'invalid_url' | 'too_long' }` and success `{ ok: true, kind, externalId?, canonicalUrl, embedUrl?, streamUrl?, strategy }`; `youtubeHostedEmbedPath(id)` = `/embed/yt/<id>` (G8 3.4 hosts it); path builders with the uuid passed in — `sermonMediaPath(orgId, sermonId, uuid, ext)`, `bulletinPath(orgId, bulletinId, uuid, ext)`, `documentPath(orgId, documentId, uuid, ext)`, `householdPhotoPath(orgId, householdId, uuid)`, `personPhotoPath(orgId, personId, uuid)`, `orgLogoPath(orgId, uuid, ext)` (G8 3.3, G9 3.5, G12 5.1, G13 5.4); `mapStorageErrorMessage` → `StorageErrorKey`; constants `SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS = 3600`, `SIGNED_URL_CACHE_MS = 50 min`, `TUS_CHUNK_SIZE_BYTES = 6 MiB`, `SHARE_LINK_MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8`, `SHARE_LINK_COOKIE_TTL_SECONDS = 86400`, `MAX_UPLOAD_MB_DEFAULT = 50`, `readMaxUploadMb(raw)`; `DIRECTORY_VIEW_LEVELS`; `SYSTEM_AUDIENCE_GROUPS` display names copied from `app.on_org_created()` ('All attendees', 'Members', 'Non-member attendees', 'Youth', 'Men', 'Women').

Names chosen by G4 in 1.6b that later groups must reuse: client-side error keys `upload_too_large_for_plan`, `upload_mime_not_allowed`, `upload_object_exists`, `upload_failed`, `network`, `unknown` (G8 3.3 upload UI) and `toDomainError` mapping SQLSTATE `23514` → `invalid_payload`; `src/urls.ts` — `APP_SCHEME = 'anacast'`, `inviteUrl(appUrl, token)`, `inviteDeepLink(token)` = `anacast://invite/<token>`, `shareLinkUrl(appUrl, token)`, `youtubeHostedEmbedUrl(appUrl, id)` (G5 2.1 invite page, G7 3.2 invitations, G8 3.4 share URL, G11 4.1/4.2 deep links + WebView must use them instead of hand-rolled strings); `sermonUploadPlanSchemaFor(maxUploadMb)` factory (G8 3.3 calls it with `readMaxUploadMb(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_MAX_UPLOAD_MB)`); `createUserDirectSchema` keys `org`, `email`, `temp_password` (≥ 12 chars — docs give no length), `display_name`, `person_id` xor `new_household { household_name, first_name, last_name }`, `perms` (snake_case; DESIGN §5 shows camelCase — recorded as a deviation; G7 3.2 must reuse this schema); RPC-backed input schemas keyed by SQL parameter names (`createInvitationSchema { org, email, person_id, perms }`, `setMembershipPermissionsSchema { membership_id, perms }`) so Server Actions pass parsed objects straight to the 1.7a wrappers; `surveys.ts` schemas (`surveySchema`, `surveyQuestionSchema`, `surveyAnswersSchema = z.record(uuid, unknown)`, `submitSurveyResponseSchema`) for G14 6.1; result schemas (`myContextSchema`, `acceptInvitationResultSchema { org_id, slug, membership_id, person_id }`, `shareResolveResultSchema`, `attachUserResultSchema`, `shareLinkCreatedSchema`) are `z.looseObject`. Added 2026-09-15 (decisions 15/21): `setHeadOfHouseSchema { hh, new_head, previous_head_role default 'spouse' }` (G12 5.1a/5.2b), `schemas/account.ts` — `archiveReasonSchema` (`user | deletion_request | admin`), `srvArchiveAccountSchema { user_id, reason }`, `srvRestoreAccountSchema { user_id }`, `archivedStateSchema { archived_at, archive_reason, deletion_scheduled_for }` (G14 6.3a); `myContextSchema.archived` (nullable) + `isArchived(ctx)`; `calendarSchema.members_can_submit`; nullable `publish_at` on `bulletinSchema`/`documentSchema`. Error keys follow 1.3b's final catalogue: NO `share_link_*` keys (statuses live in `SHARE_LINK_STATUSES`), plus `system_group_immutable`, `calendar_submissions_closed`, `account_archived`, `account_archived_by_admin`, `deletion_pending`. `limits.ts` (1.6a) carries `ACCOUNT_DELETION_GRACE_DAYS = 30` as 1.3b and 6.3a expect.

Result shapes of `accept_invitation`, `my_context` (incl. `profile`), `srv_resolve_share_link` (`ok` payload: `link_id`, `sermon { id, org_id, title, speaker, preached_on, description, media_kind, storage_path, external_url, external_id, mime_type }`, `org { name, slug, logo_path }`, `allow_download`; every other status bare `{ status }`) are mirrored from the 1.3b migration bodies; if G2's final 1.3b prompt or the executing agent changes them, 1.6b's schemas follow the migration (the prompt says the migration wins).

Names chosen by G4 in 1.7a: `ServiceDbClient` brand + `brandServiceClient()` (G5 2.1 `service.ts` must call it), `unwrap`/`unwrapMaybe`/`unwrapVoid`/`unwrapStorage`, camelCase RPC wrappers whose argument keys equal SQL parameter names, `toPgBytea(Uint8Array)` for `srv_resolve_share_link.token_hash` (G8 3.4 passes the sha256 digest bytes), `queryKeys` factory + `invalidationsFor`, `QUERY_STALE_TIME_MS` / `QUERY_GC_TIME_MS` / `SIGNED_URL_KEY_ROOT` / `shouldPersistQuery` (G5 2.1 QueryClient, G11 4.1 persister `shouldDehydrateQuery`), caller-supplied `id` for `insertSermonDraft` / `insertBulletinDraft` (G8 3.3, G9 3.5 generate it with `crypto.randomUUID()`), the 3.6 helpers in `queries/notifications.ts` / `queries/storage.ts` (`markNotificationsSent`, `markNotificationFailed`, `requeueNotification`, `insertDeliveries`, `updateDeliveryTicket`, `listPendingReceipts`, `markDeliveryReceipt`, `disablePushDeviceById`, `listObjects`, `listReferencedPaths`, `markStorageDeletionFailed`) and the 2.3 webhook helpers in `queries/billing.ts` (`getStripeEvent`, `insertStripeEvent`, `markStripeEventProcessed`, `getBillingCustomerByStripeId`, `getLatestSubscription`). Names chosen by G4 in 1.7b: `resolvePublicSupabaseEnv({ url, publishableKey, anonKey }, labels)` and `resolveServiceSupabaseEnv({ url, secretKey, serviceRoleKey })` (G5 2.1 `client.ts`/`service.ts`, G11 4.1 `supabase.ts`), `createLargeSecureStore({ secureStore, kvStore, randomBytes })` adapters and `bindAutoRefreshToAppState` (G11 4.1 wires `expo-secure-store`, `expo-sqlite/kv-store`, `expo-crypto`, RN `AppState`, and imports `react-native-url-polyfill/auto` first), `getWebBrowserClient`, subpath exports `@church/supabase-client/web` and `/mobile`.
